# Azion WebKit

> The Vue 3 design system of Azion (`@aziontech/webkit` 5.13.0): components, screen blocks with guidelines, and the design foundations, written for agents that build Azion product, marketing and docs screens.

Start every screen from a block (a reviewed, copyable screen), then fill gaps with components. Import each component from its own subpath (`@aziontech/webkit/<name>`), style only through tokens, and keep strings in the locale catalogs. These pages are generated from `catalog.json`; agents with MCP get the same data from `@aziontech/webkit-mcp` (`search_blocks`, `get_block`, `suggest_component`, `get_component`, `list_assets`). The names a component takes for its artwork (illustrations, diagrams, brand marks, icon classes) are listed in the asset foundation pages below; never guess one from a file in `src/`.

Installed copy: `node_modules/@aziontech/webkit/llms/`. Every component also has a JSON API next to its page (`components/<name>.json`).

## Foundations

- [Design tokens](foundations/tokens.md): Every visual decision comes from a token: the token groups, what to use and what lint blocks.
- [Color](foundations/color.md): Semantic color roles, light and dark themes, and the color tokens by group.
- [Typography](foundations/typography.md): The generated typography classes: font, size, line height and tracking in one class.
- [Spacing and layout](foundations/spacing.md): Page levels, the five measures, the two rhythm steps and the spacing scale.
- [Motion](foundations/motion.md): The catalogued animate-* utilities, their timing, when to use each, and reduced motion.
- [Languages (internationalization)](foundations/internationalization.md): Built-in strings in en, pt-BR and es, the provider, useLocale and locale-aware formatting.
- [Right-to-left](foundations/right-to-left.md): Logical sides only, so every screen mirrors under dir="rtl"; what mirrors and what does not.
- [Devices](foundations/devices.md): Viewport breakpoints for the shell, container queries for the content, touch targets and reflow at 320 px.
- [Accessibility](foundations/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.1 AA rules every component and screen follows: names, focus, keyboard, contrast, motion.
- [Keyboard](foundations/keyboard.md): The console keyboard contract: focus on open, Esc, Enter and Cmd+Enter, Cmd+S, Cmd+K, /, ?, list keys, and no single-key shortcut while typing.
- [Site pages (Web Design Guide)](foundations/site-pages.md): The Web Design Guide, SD-01 to SD-25 (SD-07 headline lines, SD-04 action labels): sections, heroes, line budgets and assets of every Azion web page.
- [Using WebKit in an app](foundations/usage.md): Start from a block, find a component, import it tree-shakeably, app-level setup and the quality checklist.
- [Illustrations](foundations/illustrations.md): The official product illustration scenes, drawn into the page as inline SVG and repainted from the theme.
- [Diagrams](foundations/diagrams.md): The registered product architecture diagrams.
- [Brand marks](foundations/brand-marks.md): Client, analyst and framework marks drawn as theme-aware SVG.
- [Icons](foundations/icons.md): Every icon class of `@aziontech/icons`, grouped as Azion (products, product features, platform, solutions, services), Interface (arrows, actions, status, files, media, communication, commerce, people, devices, data, l…

## Blocks: Account

- [AccountActivityHistory (account/account-activity-history)](blocks/account/account-activity-history.md): The account's audit log.
- [AccountBilling (account/account-billing)](blocks/account/account-billing.md): What the account pays, what it paid and which card it is charged to.
- [AccountChangePlanDrawer (account/account-change-plan-drawer)](blocks/account/account-change-plan-drawer.md): The drawer the Billing page opens from its Subscription Plan card.
- [AccountDeploymentSettings (account/account-deployment-settings)](blocks/account/account-deployment-settings.md): How every deploy in the account routes.
- [AccountHierarchy (account/account-hierarchy)](blocks/account/account-hierarchy.md): Where an account admin arranges the account's hierarchy.
- [AccountMfaSettings (account/account-mfa-settings)](blocks/account/account-mfa-settings.md): Multi-factor authentication for a whole account.
- [AccountOnboardingForm (account/account-onboarding-form)](blocks/account/account-onboarding-form.md): The `/signup/onboarding` screen, frame included.
- [AccountPaymentMethodCard (account/account-payment-method-card)](blocks/account/account-payment-method-card.md): The Payment method card of the Upgrade to Pro drawer.
- [AccountPersonalTokens (account/account-personal-tokens)](blocks/account/account-personal-tokens.md): The Personal tokens page of the account settings.
- [AccountTeamPermissions (account/account-team-permissions)](blocks/account/account-team-permissions.md): Who can do what in the account.
- [AccountUsers (account/account-users)](blocks/account/account-users.md): Who can sign in to the account, with which role and through which teams.

## Blocks: Ai

- [AiActionApproval (ai/ai-action-approval)](blocks/ai/ai-action-approval.md): The moment an assistant needs permission.
- [AiApiKey (ai/ai-api-key)](blocks/ai/ai-api-key.md): The place a reader brings their own key: they connect their own model provider account so the AI features of the app run on it.
- [AiChat (ai/ai-chat)](blocks/ai/ai-chat.md): A full page where a person talks with the generative AI assistant about their account: they ask in their own words, watch the response arrive, check where it came from, and keep going with a follow-up or a new question.
- [AiChatDrawer (ai/ai-chat-drawer)](blocks/ai/ai-chat-drawer.md): The generative AI assistant beside the work: the reader is on a resource page — here a workload whose error rate is up — and opens the assistant in a drawer to ask about what they see, without losing the page.

## Blocks: Auth

- [AuthSignIn (auth/auth-sign-in)](blocks/auth/auth-sign-in.md): The signed-out screens of a platform app: sign in, sign up, reset password and check your inbox, frame included.

## Blocks: Create

- [CreateDeployDrawer (create/create-deploy-drawer)](blocks/create/create-deploy-drawer.md): The drawer a platform deploys from, opened by Deploy on a service or a project.
- [CreateDeployProgressDialog (create/create-deploy-progress-dialog)](blocks/create/create-deploy-progress-dialog.md): The modal progress of one deploy that sends several Deployment Settings live, each on its own, and the drop-to-deploy confirm that starts it.
- [CreateDeploySuccess (create/create-deploy-success)](blocks/create/create-deploy-success.md): The screen a create flow ends on.
- [CreateDeployTemplate (create/create-deploy-template)](blocks/create/create-deploy-template.md): A focused page, outside the console shell, where the user turns a template into a running project.
- [CreateDrawer (create/create-drawer)](blocks/create/create-drawer.md): The right-side drawer that adds or edits something that only exists inside another resource: a domain, a DNS record, an environment, a variable, a rule.
- [CreateHub (create/create-hub)](blocks/create/create-hub.md): The Creation Center, where a new project starts.
- [CreatePage (create/create-page)](blocks/create/create-page.md): The page a first-level resource is created on when everything it needs fits on one screen.
- [CreateReleaseImpact (create/create-release-impact)](blocks/create/create-release-impact.md): The Review and deploy page of a release that carries several resources at once: a service, the policy in front of it, its storage, its error page and every dependency they reference.
- [CreateResourcePicker (create/create-resource-picker)](blocks/create/create-resource-picker.md): The band a create flow uses when the resource being created needs another resource that may already exist.
- [CreateWizard (create/create-wizard)](blocks/create/create-wizard.md): The page a first-level resource is created on one step at a time.

- [DashboardAnalytics (dashboard/dashboard-analytics)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-analytics.md): The page a developer or operator opens to see how much traffic their services handled and how well they handled it: requests, data transferred, success rate and server errors for the period, then the charts and the ta…

- [DashboardConfigurable (dashboard/dashboard-configurable)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-configurable.md): A dashboard the reader arranges: they move cards, change how many columns a card spans and how tall it is, and keep that layout.
- [DashboardExecutiveSummary (dashboard/dashboard-executive-summary)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-executive-summary.md): The one page a lead reads to see how the quarter went: the headline results against last quarter, the twelve-month trend behind each one, progress on the quarter's goals and the notes the leads wrote when they reviewe…
- [DashboardHealthScore (dashboard/dashboard-health-score)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-health-score.md): The page that answers "how well does this work for the people who use it, and where is it worst?".
- [DashboardHome (dashboard/dashboard-home)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-home.md): The Console's Home page: the first screen a signed-in user lands on.
- [DashboardScanResults (dashboard/dashboard-scan-results)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-scan-results.md): The page for a pipeline that sends items (files, attachments, packages) for analysis and gives each a verdict.
- [DashboardSecurity (dashboard/dashboard-security)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-security.md): The page a reader opens to see what their security rules are doing: how many requests were blocked and inspected, how blocking moved over time, which attack categories and countries it came from, which source addresse…
- [DashboardServiceMonitoring (dashboard/dashboard-service-monitoring)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-service-monitoring.md): The page an on-call engineer keeps open: is every service up, how fast is it answering, how many requests fail, and which alerts are open right now.
- [DashboardSwitcher (dashboard/dashboard-switcher)](blocks/dashboard/dashboard-switcher.md): The dashboards hub.

## Blocks: Detail

- [DetailCustomer (detail/detail-customer)](blocks/detail/detail-customer.md): Preview. The page a support agent opens to learn who is asking: how to reach the customer, how happy they have been, every ticket they opened, what happened on their account, and the notes other agents left.
- [DetailDeploymentLogs (detail/detail-deployment-logs)](blocks/detail/detail-deployment-logs.md): The user started a deployment and wants to know where it is, whether it went live and, when it did not, exactly which step failed and why.
- [DetailDnsZone (detail/detail-dns-zone)](blocks/detail/detail-dns-zone.md): The detail page of a resource that owns a long list of records, here a DNS zone.
- [DetailDomainsCard (detail/detail-domains-card)](blocks/detail/detail-domains-card.md): A short list of the things one resource is attached to, shown in place inside its Settings tab.
- [DetailGetStarted (detail/detail-get-started)](blocks/detail/detail-get-started.md): The first thing a user reads about a resource they created from the CLI and have not deployed yet.
- [DetailInvocations (detail/detail-invocations)](blocks/detail/detail-invocations.md): The page a user opens to understand one run of a function: did it work, how long did it take, where did the time go, and what did the code print.
- [DetailProductionChecklist (detail/detail-production-checklist)](blocks/detail/detail-production-checklist.md): A service that is live on its generated hostname is not yet ready for real traffic.
- [DetailResource (detail/detail-resource)](blocks/detail/detail-resource.md): The second-level page of one resource.
- [DetailVersion (detail/detail-version)](blocks/detail/detail-version.md): One version of a resource, opened from its Versions tab.

## Blocks: Edit

- [EditDeleteDialog (edit/edit-delete-dialog)](blocks/edit/edit-delete-dialog.md): The last stop before a resource is gone for good.
- [EditFunction (edit/edit-function)](blocks/edit/edit-function.md): The editing page of a service whose behavior lives in source code.
- [EditResource (edit/edit-resource)](blocks/edit/edit-resource.md): The settings page of one existing resource.
- [EditRuleBuilder (edit/edit-rule-builder)](blocks/edit/edit-rule-builder.md): A drawer where the user writes one rule of a rules engine: when it runs (the phase), the conditions that decide whether it applies, and the ordered behaviors it performs when they match.
- [EditSchema (edit/edit-schema)](blocks/edit/edit-schema.md): The table schema of a SQL database: the definition of one table and the drawers and dialogs that change it.
- [EditVariables (edit/edit-variables)](blocks/edit/edit-variables.md): A list of key and value pairs and the drawer that edits them, here environment variables.

## Blocks: Settings

- [SettingsForm (settings/settings-form)](blocks/settings/settings-form.md): The place the user goes to change how an account or a project behaves.

- [StatePageSkeleton (state/state-page-skeleton)](blocks/state/state-page-skeleton.md): The skeleton wires an app paints while a page is still arriving.

## Blocks: Top Bar

- [TopBarCreation (top-bar/top-bar-creation)](blocks/top-bar/top-bar-creation.md): The top bar of the focused creation shell: create, edit and deploy flows that run without the navigation rail.

## Blocks: View

- [ViewCard (view/view-card)](blocks/view/view-card.md): The first-level index of one resource type, in cards.
- [ViewEventsExplorer (view/view-events-explorer)](blocks/view/view-events-explorer.md): The events explorer.

- [ViewQueryEditor (view/view-query-editor)](blocks/view/view-query-editor.md): The workspace of one SQL database.
- [ViewRuleList (view/view-rule-list)](blocks/view/view-rule-list.md): An ordered list of rules grouped by phase: the Rules tab of an application (Request and Response phases) or a firewall (Request only).
- [ViewTable (view/view-table)](blocks/view/view-table.md): The first-level index of one resource type, in rows.
- [ViewTemplateBrowser (view/view-template-browser)](blocks/view/view-template-browser.md): The catalog of templates a person starts a project from.
- [ViewWafTuning (view/view-waf-tuning)](blocks/view/view-waf-tuning.md): The Tuning tab of a WAF rule set.

## Components: Actions

- [Button](components/button.md): The labelled control that triggers an action.
- [ButtonGroup](components/button-group.md): A toolbar of icon actions that belong to one surface (a code panel, a table header, a preview), after Cloudscape's button group.
- [CopyButton](components/copy-button.md): Icon-only control that copies a string to the clipboard and briefly confirms success.
- [CopyPromptButton](components/copy-prompt-button.md): The "Copy prompt" button of a docs or product home: one dark chip that copies a ready-made prompt for a coding agent and, after its label, shows the marks of the agents it works with (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Curso…
- [HighlightButton](components/highlight-button.md): Visually emphasized action trigger built on a brand-accent gradient with a continuously rotating multicolor glow rim behind the surface (ported from the `azion-console-kit` Copilot button).
- [IconButton](components/icon-button.md): A square control that triggers an action with a glyph and no visible text: close, refresh, delete, more.
- [SearchTrigger](components/search-trigger.md): The field-shaped button in a top bar that opens search: a magnifier, a muted label (`Search` by default) and the keycap of the shortcut that opens the same palette (`⌘K` on macOS, `Ctrl K` elsewhere, drawn by `Kbd`).
- [SplitButton](components/split-button.md): A primary command button visually joined to a chevron toggle that opens an overlay menu of related actions defined by an `items` array.
- [ToggleGroup](components/toggle-group.md): ToggleGroup is a connected group of buttons that picks exactly one value out of a small set of related options, with a selection indicator that slides to the active segment.

- [ResponseBranches](components/response-branches.md): Pages through alternative versions of one assistant response or one edited prompt: after Try again, after the reader edits a prompt, or when the model returned several candidates, the message shows one version at a ti…
- [ResponseLoading](components/response-loading.md): Use ResponseLoading only while a generative AI answer is being produced; never for loading product data, which uses Skeleton (known shape), Spinner (inline) or Progress (measurable).
- [Sources](components/sources.md): The sources a generative AI response drew on (ChatGPT's Sources, Cloudscape's sources section, AI Elements Sources): a small `Sources` pill with the overlapping marks of up to three cited sources that opens a panel li…
- [StreamingResponse](components/streaming-response.md): Renders a model's Markdown as it streams in (AI Elements Response / Streamdown), safely.

- [ToolCall](components/tool-call.md): One tool or command the agent invoked, shown in the conversation (AI Elements Tool, Cloudscape progressive steps): a row with the tool name in code font, an optional plain description, and a status (`Waiting`, `Prepar…

## Components: Charts

- [BarList](components/bar-list.md): Use BarList for a ranked top-N breakdown inside a chart card; a list of mixed rows with actions is Item rows.
- [Chart](components/chart.md): A cartesian chart — lines, areas, stacked areas, bars, mixed bars and lines, and scatter dots over one category axis — composed from parts the consumer places by hand.
- [ChartCard](components/chart-card.md): Use ChartCard as the frame of a chart on a dashboard; for one box of other content use Card, and for a collection of records as cards use CardList.
- [DonutChart](components/donut-chart.md): A part-to-whole chart drawn as a ring (donut) or a disc (pie): one slice per series, the total in the center, a legend beside it.
- [GaugeChart](components/gauge-chart.md): Use GaugeChart for one value against a known range with thresholds; for threshold lines or bands inside a Chart use Chart.Reference, and for one headline metric with a delta use StatTile.
- [MapChart](components/map-chart.md): Values by place on the dotted world map of `NetworkMap`: countries shaded on a five-step sequential scale (a choropleth on the dot grid) and locations drawn as bubbles whose area follows the value.
- [SparkChart](components/spark-chart.md): A word-sized chart: one series drawn as an area, a line or bars, with no axes, grid, legend or tooltip, filling the width of its container at a fixed height.
- [StatTile](components/stat-tile.md): Use StatTile to show one headline metric (figure, delta, sparkline) in product UI; the strip of related metrics is a StatTileGroup, one value against a range with thresholds is a GaugeChart, and a money amount on its…
- [StatTileGroup](components/stat-tile-group.md): Use StatTileGroup for the strip of related metrics at the top of a product overview; one metric on its own is a StatTile.
- [Tracker](components/tracker.md): Use Tracker for the history of a state across periods (an uptime strip); the current state of one resource is a StatusIndicator.

## Components: Code

- [CodeBlock](components/code-block.md): Use CodeBlock to show code, config or JSON the person reads or copies, including read-only diffs (a tab's `original`); for code the person edits use CodeEditor, and for build, deploy or runtime log lines use LogViewer.
- [CodeEditor](components/code-editor.md): Use CodeEditor only when the person edits the code (its diff mode is for editing one side beside the original); to show code, config or JSON the person reads or copies, including read-only diffs, use CodeBlock, and fo…
- [LogViewer](components/log-viewer.md): Composition-based terminal log viewer for CI/deploy output.
- [Trace](components/trace.md): A span waterfall: one row per span of a run (a function invocation, a request through several services), indented under the span it ran inside and drawn as a bar placed against the run's own clock.

## Components: Content

- [Accordion](components/accordion.md): A vertically stacked set of disclosure items: each item has a clickable header that expands or collapses its content panel.
- [AudioPlayer](components/audio-player.md): A compact player for one audio clip: play and pause, a seek bar between the current time and the duration, mute and volume, and, when asked for, a playback speed control, a download link and a transcript.
- [Avatar](components/avatar.md): Identifies a person, an account or an organization with a small visual mark: their picture when there is one, otherwise their initials, a fallback icon or a generated pattern seeded by the name.
- [AvatarGroup](components/avatar-group.md): Shows the people behind one thing as a row of overlapping avatars: the members of a team, the owners of a resource, who is viewing a page now.
- [Badge](components/badge.md): Use Badge only for a number attached to something else (unread count, 12, 99+).
- [Brand](components/brand.md): The Azion brand logo, rendered as an inline SVG lockup.
- [BrowserFrame](components/browser-frame.md): A browser window that renders live webkit components inside a viewport of its own, so a page or story can show a real screen at a real device size — desktop, tablet or mobile — and resize it by hand.
- [Card](components/card.md): Use Card for one bordered box of related content in product UI; for a collection of records shown as cards use CardList, for a catalog tile use IntegrationCard, and for the frame of a dashboard chart use ChartCard.
- [Carousel](components/carousel.md): A horizontally scrollable track of cards with snap points and a pair of step controls.
- [ConsoleMockup](components/console-mockup.md): Draws one of the **official console widgets**: a scaled, inert mock of an Azion Console screen or fragment, built from real webkit components inside an internal `ConsoleMockupShell` frame (not exported), that marketin…
- [CopyText](components/copy-text.md): CopyText shows one code value (a CSS custom property, a utility class, a CNAME, a key ID, a one-line command) in monospace inside a quiet bordered box, with an always-visible `CopyButton` at its inline end that copies…
- [Countdown](components/countdown.md): Preview. Countdown shows the time left until a deadline as a compact tag: the SLA badge of a support ticket (`Due in 2h 15m`, `Due tomorrow`, `Overdue by 15m`), or the time before a certificate or a trial expires (`Expires in…
- [CurrencyAmount](components/currency-amount.md): Use CurrencyAmount to typeset one money amount anywhere; a money metric with a delta and a sparkline is a StatTile.
- [Embed](components/embed.md): A responsive `iframe` for third-party content — a demo, a player, a status page, a form — that keeps its aspect ratio at every width and always carries the accessible name an `iframe` needs.
- [Eyebrow](components/eyebrow.md): Overline is the short uppercase label set above a headline to name the section, panel or group it opens (the "eyebrow").
- [FilePreview](components/file-preview.md): The preview of one stored file in a storage or object browser, or of a document in an AI conversation (a PDF the reader attaches or a model returns): a header with the file's glyph, name, type and size, a Download act…
- [HelpPanel](components/help-panel.md): The content of a help side region: a topic's title, a few sections of short guidance, and the "Learn more" links that leave for the documentation.
- [Illustration](components/illustration.md): Renders an **official product illustration** — one of the scenes drawn in the Assets library in Figma and exported as an SVG that ships with this package.
- [ImageGallery](components/image-gallery.md): The images of one response: a responsive grid of thumbnails that opens one image larger in a `Dialog`, with previous, next and Download.
- [IntegrationCard](components/integration-card.md): Use IntegrationCard for one tile of a catalog of integrations, extensions or plugins; for a bordered box of related content use Card, and for a collection of resource records shown as cards use CardList.

- [SeverityTag](components/severity-tag.md): Use SeverityTag only for a level on the critical → info scale of findings and alerts; the state of a resource is a StatusIndicator, and any other category word is a Tag.
- [StatusCode](components/status-code.md): Use StatusCode only for an HTTP status code or method (200, 404, GET); for resource state use StatusIndicator, and for any other word use Tag.
- [Tag](components/tag.md): Use Tag for a read-only category or outcome word on an item (Production, Beta, Allowed) that is not a lifecycle state.

## Components: Feedback

- [Alert](components/alert.md): Use Alert for a persistent message on a console page or section (info, warning, error) — the answer for 'banner' or 'notice'.
- [EmptyState](components/empty-state.md): Centered placeholder shown when a resource list or section has no content yet.
- [ErrorBoundary](components/error-boundary.md): Guards one region of a page.
- [OutcomeIcon](components/outcome-icon.md): Use OutcomeIcon for the bare round glyph that says how one run ended, with no label; with a label, the state of a resource is a StatusIndicator.
- [Progress](components/progress.md): Use Progress when the work has a measurable amount (value/max), or for a long task with no layout to reserve (indeterminate).
- [Skeleton](components/skeleton.md): Use Skeleton when a region with a known shape (text, table rows, cards, avatars) is still loading — the default answer to 'show a loading state'.
- [Spinner](components/spinner.md): Use Spinner only for an inline busy mark in a row, log line or custom control that has no loading prop; buttons use their own `loading`, a loading region with a known shape uses Skeleton, and measurable work uses Prog…
- [StatusIndicator](components/status-indicator.md): Use StatusIndicator for the current state of one resource (Active, Failed, Deploying) in a table column or detail header — the default answer for 'status'.
- [Toast](components/toast.md): Use Toast for a short confirmation after an action that disappears on its own; a persistent message on a page or section (a banner, a notice) is an Alert.
- [UploadProgress](components/upload-progress.md): Use UploadProgress for a floating card that tracks a background transfer while the person keeps working; the files picked in a form field are a FileTokenGroup, and one measurable task in place is a Progress.

- [OtpInput](components/otp-input.md): The field for a one-time code: the six digits an authenticator app shows, or a code sent by email or SMS.
- [PasswordInput](components/password-input.md): Single-line password input for forms.

- [RadioGroup](components/radio-group.md): RadioGroup is the one "pick one of a few" component: it picks exactly one value from a short list of labelled options shown at once.
- [Rating](components/rating.md): Preview. Rating is a row of stars that picks a whole score from 1 to `max` (5 by default), the way a customer rates a support conversation (CSAT) or a product review.
- [SchemaForm](components/schema-form.md): A form rendered from a JSON schema: each property of an object schema becomes a `Field` with its label, description, Required marker and control, and a nested object becomes a fieldset with its own legend.
- [Select](components/select.md): Select control for choosing exactly one option from a list; several values are `multi-select`.
- [Slider](components/slider.md): Bare range control `Slider`: one thumb on a horizontal track that picks a single number between `min` and `max` in `step` increments, with the portion from `min` to the value filled.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every foundation, block and product (`app`) component page in one file: block guidelines with their parts and variants as names and without their code, and the first example of each component (the pages above hold the code, every example and every detail).
- [llms-full-site.txt](llms-full-site.txt): the same cut for the marketing and documentation site components (surface `site` and `docs`).
- [catalog.json](../catalog.json): the machine catalog the pages are generated from (exports, props, tokens, blocks).
